name: PhotoBlocks Gallery
author: wpcraftnet

sections.description:
WP PhotoBlocks is a clean and intuitive Gutenberg block plugin that allows WordPress users to easily create stunning photo galleries using the block editor. Perfect for photographers, bloggers, artists, small businesses, or anyone who wants to showcase visual content in a stylish, responsive layout.

With drag-and-drop image uploads, adjustable column layouts, spacing controls, and optional captions, WP PhotoBlocks helps you present your images exactly the way you want—right inside the native block editor.

No more clunky shortcodes or third-party interfaces—just fast, simple, and visually rich galleries built directly in Gutenberg.

Whether you’re building a portfolio, travel blog, or product showcase, WP PhotoBlocks gives you a simple, reliable, and elegant way to make your photos shine.

🔓 Free Features:

  • Create photo galleries using the native block editor
  • Responsive image grid layout with customizable columns and gap spacing
  • Optional image captions
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • Clean front-end output with minimal CSS
  • Future support for layout types like Carousel or Masonry (planned)

🔐 Pro Features:

  • Carousel and Lightbox layouts
  • Infinite scrolling
  • Toggleable navigation arrows for Carousel and Lightbox

Usage

  1. Create or edit a post or page
  2. Open the Gutenberg Block Editor
  3. Click the “+” button and search for RK Photo Gallery Block
  4. Add images from your media library or upload new ones
  5. Configure layout, image size, and other settings from the block sidebar

License

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the rk-photo-gallery-block.zip file
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Extract the contents to /wp-content/plugins/rk-photo-gallery-block/
  3. Go to the WordPress admin panel and activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support the Classic Editor?

No. RK Photo Gallery Block is built specifically for the Gutenberg (Block) Editor.

Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes, the plugin works with any theme that supports Gutenberg blocks.

How can I access Pro features?

You will need to upgrade to the Pro version to unlock Carousel, Lightbox, and additional features.

Can I define custom image sizes?

Yes. The plugin allows selecting predefined sizes or setting a custom width and height.
